Vibration needs two physical effects

• One effect is called a (viscous) spring. It’s the springiness in
 many things around you. (I will ignore “viscous”). It has a
 property we call stiffness.
• The other effect is called mass.
• We will now discuss each of these to understand what vibration
  is, and remmebr how important vibration is:
     • It’s what you feel when you hit a bump in your car
     • It’s music
     • It’s boom and bust in economics
     • It’s oscillation in SGD
     • It’s the motion of the air in your vocal tract and the motion of your vocal
      folds, when you speak
